name: Fine-Tuning Workflow
description: Decide whether to fine-tune, then prepare/validate/evaluate a dataset safely.
required_inputs: example inputs/outputs (no private user data without consent)

stages.task: If not tuning, fix via prompt/examples instead
Build dataset (sanitized, split) + baseline eval; run tuning; measure delta
Confirm the delta justifies the cost and there is a rollback

quality_checks: tuned model beats baseline on the metric
final_deliverable: A justified tuning decision with a sanitized dataset, before/after eval, and rollback record.
